difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a filtered colimit of K-flat complexes of O-modules on a ringed site is K-flat (statement lines 3151-3157). The proof is a two-step reduction: because the colimit of complexes is taken termwise, the total tensor product commutes with it, colim_i Tot(F^bullet tensor K_i^bullet) = Tot(F^bullet tensor colim_i K_i^bullet) (proof lines 3160-3167), and testing against an acyclic F^bullet each member of the system is acyclic by K-flatness, so exactness of filtered colimits gives acyclicity of the colimit (proof lines 3167-3169). The content is the termwise commutation of the tensor product with the colimit together with exactness of filtered colimits. The claim is H2: one displayed identity plus one standard exactness property.
